Auto svg conversion with accessible names disabled

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var optionsJson = "{\"inline_data_media\":\"AltTextOnly\",\"tier_strategy\":\"auto\"}";
        var options = JsonUtil.fromJson(optionsJson, ConversionOptions.class);
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convertWithAccessibleNames("<p><svg aria-label=\"Name\"><text>Drawn</text></svg></p>", false, options);
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
